H5a_AHU9_exploratory.claim: T_PLUS_U improves Event Recall over T_ONLY on AHU9 with FAR <= 5%
H5a_AHU9_exploratory.notes: Exploratory gain (+3 events, +50% relative gain) observed on AHU9 under identical FAR budget <= 5% (3.63% vs 2.79%).

H5b_AHU10_confirmatory.claim: T_PLUS_U improves Event Recall over T_ONLY on AHU10 under recipient local calibration with FAR <= 5%
H5b_AHU10_confirmatory.notes: On independent recipient AHU10, T_PLUS_U yields 6/36, exactly matching T_ONLY (6/36, delta=0), while increasing false alarms from 1.28% to 3.83%. Pre-registered confirmatory hypothesis H5b is refuted.
